output.headline: Advocate Health and UPMC plus provider-focused sponsors form the buyer universe for this Midwest healthcare services target; upper-quartile pricing is defensible.
sentences: Call Advocate Health first, with 5 deals in the target's own sub-sector and a closed $436M deal, then Nordic Capital and UPMC, which has 3 sub-sector deals. [E:tier1]

Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, at 15.3x EBITDA, the 75th percentile, backed by the 16.8% margin; Advocate Health and UPMC can pay it comfortably, while sponsors top out at $193M to $216M. [E:valuation, E:lbo, E:tier1]

The review removed Steward Health Care (Chapter 11), merged Atrium Health into Advocate Health, and kept Veritas Capital, Vista Equity and Francisco Partners in Tier 2 pending a check of their appetite. [E:review, E:tier2]
Geographic expansion drives 90% of 284 provider deals, so lead every pitch with how the target extends the buyer's footprint in the Midwest. [E:motives]
